name: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt

status.en: 455 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 36% more than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 455 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 36 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces are conducting search operations in Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch and Mendhar districts while an encounter in Kupwara's Keran sector killed two terrorists, and another infiltration attempt was foiled in the same district. In Manipur, fresh firing in Kamjong injured four civilians including a village chief, and a Kuki-Zo woman was killed and her husband wounded in an ambush by suspected Naga militants. The Indian Army and Assam Rifles are launching water-security and skill-development projects in Manipur, while apple cultivation is expanding at the expense of rice fields, raising food-security concerns. 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker gjennomfører søkeoperasjoner i Jammu og Kasjmir sine distrikter Poonch og Mendhar, mens et møte i Kupwaras Keran-sektor drepte to terrorister, og et annet infiltrasjonsforsøk ble avverget i samme distrikt. I Manipur førte ny skyting i Kamjong til fire sivile skadde, inkludert en landsbyleder, og en Kuki-Zo-kvinne ble drept og hennes ektemann såret i et bakholdsangrep av mistenkte Naga-militante. Den indiske hæren og Assam Rifles starter vann-sikkerhets‑ og kompetanseutviklingsprosjekter i Manipur, mens epledyrking utvider seg på bekostning av risåkre, noe som gir bekymringer for matsikkerheten. 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
